rule: Cash everywhere it applies (owner rule 2026-11-10): wherever money is taken in person, cash is always one of the choices, next to the electronic ways.
rules: Cash never needs a provider and never needs the network: a cash payment is never blocked, also offline.
The person taking the cash confirms it with one tap after counting; the record is PaymentRecorded with method cash and status cash_received.
Cash joins the expected cash of the till or shift it was taken on, and is checked at the cash count.
Electronic ways keep their own rule: nothing is handed over or marked paid until the provider confirms.
Cash taken for someone else (a rider or a pickup point collecting for a seller) belongs to that seller: the app records who owes what, and LynkOmni never holds, pools or moves it.
Cash is never offered where nobody is there to take it (remote payments) or where a licensed partner must confirm first (agent point services).

whose_cash.own: The cash belongs to the business taking it and goes into its till.
whose_cash.held_for_seller: The cash belongs to the seller; the person collecting owes it to them, and the app records the amount owed.
whose_cash.customer_pays_business: A customer settles what they owe the business in person; the cash goes into the till.

points.what: A sale at the counter, table or market stall
A sale on a button phone or by USSD, text or voice
A parcel with money due, collected at the shop's own pickup counter
An invoice paid in person: the business records the cash against the invoice
A customer pays off what they owe on credit, in person
A Storefront order or service paid when the customer and the seller meet
An order paid to the rider at the door
A parcel with money due, collected at a pickup point run by someone other than the seller
A rental or its extra charges paid when the item is handed over or returned
A booking paid at the venue, on arrival or after the service

not_applicable.why: Pay links, QR and online checkout are paid from somewhere else: nobody is there to take cash.
A LynkOmni plan is paid to LynkOmni through the payment partner, never in cash.
A LynkVCard is loaded and spent through the licensed issuer.
At an agent point the cash is the agent's own and changes hands only after the licensed partner confirms: its own rule stays.
Exchange runs only through its licensed partner.
